tests.title: parses positional and named i/c options as native does and refuses every unimplemented form with an exact message
negotiates the native list: integers widen to flt, floats keep their type, planar input stays planar, and the encoder format merges
declares no constraint, keeps counts and packet sections, and reserves one frame plus the per-channel previous value
matches a direct C transcription for forward and inverse recurrences, packed and planar, with state carried across arbitrary frame splits
converts integer input to its negotiated float format, owns every output plane and leaves inputs untouched
enforces the frame allocation limit, refuses a channel count change and observes cancellation
matches native framecrc for i {-10,-3,0,2,10} x c {0,1}, packed and planar, on every source into f32, f64 and s16
matches native across channel counts, multi-frame input, asetnsamples splits and composed chains
matches native output time selection, frame limits and WAV/raw files
fails every unimplemented form before opening output, and records native status for each

compares: 450 framecrc: i {-10,-3,0,2,10} x c {0,1} x packed/fltp/dblp x u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 stereo sources x pcm_f32le/pcm_f64le/pcm_s16le, -cpuflags 0
132 framecrc: mono and 3-channel s16/f32/f64, 11 chains incl. asetnsamples splits (1/7/13/500/64), i=2.5, chained crystalizers, volume, aformat, apad, into source codec and s16
13: output -ss/-t/-to/-frames:a framecrc, WAV->WAV f32/s16 and raw f64 file bytes
11: native exit status for 10 refused option forms plus one shared negotiation-guard case, with no edge output created
nativeComparisons.platformGate: byte comparisons skipped unless linux x64

unsupported: option expressions, SI suffixes, nan/inf, quoted or escaped values
FLAC input (refused before decoding; flacInput not declared)
automatic sample-rate conversion after the filter (native-list rule)
neighbour negotiations refused by the shared guard, e.g. crystalizer,volume=0.25:precision=double on f32 input and crystalizer,volume=0.25 on f64 input
byte-exact claims on platforms other than linux x64

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
Setup durations: submodule 35s, npm ci 7s, reference:build 140s, baseline static checks 52s, baseline unit suite 67s.
The shared negotiation guard refuses some volume-after-crystalizer chains (see unsupported); that behaviour is in chain.ts and was not changed.
Baseline failures are the expected FLAC artifact tests (downloads.xiph.org blocked) and resample-checkpoint macOS digests.
